scams.name: Laundry Per-Piece Billing
scams.setup: Laundry service quotes a price that sounds like a flat/bag rate.
scams.mechanism: Later clarified as per individual item, inflating the bill (e.g. charged per sock).
scams.countermeasure: Confirm 'per kilo/bag' vs 'per piece' pricing before handing over laundry.

scams.name: Unrequested Table Items
scams.setup: Water, bread, or appetizers placed on the table without being ordered.
scams.mechanism: Assumed complimentary by many travelers, then charged.
scams.countermeasure: Ask 'is this included?' before consuming anything not explicitly ordered.

scams.name: Manual Receipt Padding
scams.setup: Cashier manually adds a small extra line item to a receipt.
scams.mechanism: Tests whether the customer checks the total; easily reversed if caught, rarely challenged if not.
scams.countermeasure: Review itemized receipts before paying, especially at tourist-area shops/markets.
